name: ea-plays
description: The 'with the kit' layer for the AI plays and usage tips of four Knowledge Product courses on digital government — enterprise architecture, the interoperability framework, the education DPI roadmap and service design: checks work against PAERA as published and looks PAERA up by section and public address, drafts the governance documents and the interoperability decree against public sources, and turns open questions into one page of decision cards for the post that rules. Plays run bare in any assistant; this kit adds the sources and the verification.
